templates.name: Stranded Divers
templates.setup: Divers are trapped outside their vessel or installation with limited air.

stages.contact: The beacon provides a short survival window.
stages.crisis: Terrain, creatures, or failing equipment blocks direct recovery.
stages.aftermath: The crew must choose who and what can be saved.

complications: One diver refuses to leave a companion.
Their employer denies the mission existed.
The beacon attracts predators.
opportunities: Recovered tools and samples are valuable.
templates.reward: Survivors are recovered and become witnesses, allies, or crew candidates.
templates.failure: Medical stores are consumed and lives may be lost.
templates.persistent: Named survivors retain opinions about the crew's choices.

templates.name: Quarantine Distress Call
templates.setup: A vessel requests aid while reporting illness, contamination, or unexplained behavioral changes.

stages.crisis: Someone aboard attempts to break quarantine.
stages.aftermath: The rescuers must treat the crisis without importing it.

complications: The disease is fabricated to hide mutiny.
The sick are infected with husk.
The distress vessel carries critical cargo.
opportunities: A correct diagnosis yields research data.
The rescued crew offers payment and testimony.
templates.reward: The crisis is contained and survivors receive treatment.
templates.failure: Medical supplies are lost and contamination reaches the crew.
templates.persistent: Unresolved symptoms remain a campaign condition until examined at a station.

templates.name: Disabled Submarine
templates.setup: A submarine with survivors has lost propulsion, ballast control, or hull integrity.

stages.crisis: The disabled vessel begins sinking or drifting toward danger.
stages.aftermath: The crew must decide between tow, evacuation, or abandonment.

complications: The survivors conceal dangerous cargo.
The tow point is structurally unsound.
The vessel belongs to a hostile faction.
opportunities: The rescued crew pays in supplies or intelligence.
The vessel can become a salvage claim.
templates.reward: The crew saves lives and receives material or political reward.
templates.failure: The rescue damages both vessels and consumes fuel.
templates.persistent: Saving or abandoning the vessel changes faction reputation.

templates.name: Mutiny Beacon
templates.setup: Conflicting distress calls accuse officers and crew of mutiny, murder, or piracy.

stages.crisis: Evidence is destroyed while the submarine approaches.
stages.aftermath: The crew must intervene without becoming another faction in the mutiny.

complications: The captain is infected.
The mutineers uncovered a real crime.
A station ordered the dispute buried.
templates.reward: The crew prevents further bloodshed and preserves evidence.
templates.failure: Violence, delay, and political liability follow.
templates.persistent: The chosen side becomes a recurring ally or enemy.

templates.name: Exposed Mineral Bloom
templates.setup: A geological event exposes a dense field of useful minerals.

stages.contact: The deposit appears easy to harvest.
stages.crisis: The site begins destabilizing under extraction.
stages.aftermath: The crew must stop at profit rather than greed.

complications: The minerals interfere with sonar.
Another prospector has a claim marker.
Extraction wakes local fauna.
opportunities: The deposit can become a mapped resource node.
templates.reward: The crew gains supplies, credits, or research material.
templates.failure: Overreach damages equipment and adds route danger.
templates.persistent: A carefully mapped bloom may be revisited until depleted.

templates.name: Abandoned Supply Cache
templates.setup: A sealed cache of fuel, provisions, tools, or medicine is found off the main route.

stages.crisis: A trap, claim, or environmental threat becomes apparent.
stages.aftermath: The crew must determine whether the cache is rescue, bait, or evidence.

complications: The cache belongs to missing colonists.
One container is contaminated.
The coordinates were broadcast deliberately.
opportunities: The cache log reveals a hidden route.
templates.failure: The crew wastes time and loses supplies to a trap or contamination.
templates.persistent: The origin of the cache can seed a later mystery.

templates.name: Rare Biological Sample
templates.setup: An unusual organism, tissue mass, or living colony could transform current research.

stages.aftermath: The crew must preserve scientific value without endangering the vessel.

complications: The organism mimics harmless life.
A faction has banned its possession.
It reacts to sonar or reactor output.
opportunities: The sample advances medicine or xenobiology.
A safe collection method becomes a new tool.
templates.reward: The crew secures valuable research material.
templates.failure: Containment failure consumes medical stores and damages a system.
templates.persistent: The specimen remains a tracked cargo or research asset.

templates.name: Unscheduled Trade Rendezvous
templates.setup: A trader offers fuel, medicine, ammunition, or information far from a normal market.

stages.crisis: The trader demands secrecy or immediate commitment.
stages.aftermath: The crew must decide whether the opportunity justifies the risk.

complications: The goods are stolen.
The trader is fleeing a faction.
One item is uniquely valuable.
opportunities: The meeting creates a recurring supplier.
Information replaces part of the payment.
templates.reward: The crew gains useful supplies at a favorable exchange.
templates.failure: Counterfeit goods or betrayal cost credits and readiness.
templates.persistent: The trader remembers whether the crew protected or exposed them.
